name: ocultar-pii
description: Zero-egress PII redaction for Claude workflows. Redacts names, emails, IBANs, SSNs, phone numbers, and credit cards before any AI processing. Runs entirely in your infrastructure — no data ever leaves your environment.
long_description:
Ocultar is a local PII detection and redaction engine. This extension gives Claude six tools:

- **refine_text** — redacts PII from any text before it reaches Claude, replacing sensitive values with deterministic tokens (e.g. `[EMAIL_9c8f7a1b]`).
- **reveal_tokens** — de-tokenizes tokens back to plaintext for authorized callers (auditor-only, every call is logged in an immutable Ed25519-signed audit trail).
- **register_entity** / **list_entities** / **seed_entities** — manage the persistent Entity Registry so name variants (e.g. 'Alice', 'A. Martin') resolve to the same token across sessions (auditor-only).
- **sombra_query** — ask a redacted question through the Ocultar Sombra gateway, which redacts PII, routes to the chosen LLM, and rehydrates the response (requires Sombra running separately).

All processing happens on your machine via the locally running Ocultar Refinery (and Sombra, for sombra_query). If either service is unreachable, every tool fails closed — raw text is never forwarded. Zero-egress is an architectural property, not a policy.

ocultar_url.title: Ocultar Refinery URL
ocultar_url.description: URL of your locally running Ocultar Refinery

ocultar_api_key.title: API Key
ocultar_api_key.description: Ocultar API key (leave blank if not configured)

ocultar_auditor_token.title: Auditor Token
ocultar_auditor_token.description: Enables reveal_tokens and the Entity Registry tools (register_entity, list_entities, seed_entities). Must match OCU_AUDITOR_TOKEN on the server. Leave blank to disable these tools.

ocultar_sombra_url.title: Ocultar Sombra Gateway URL
ocultar_sombra_url.description: URL of your locally running Ocultar Sombra gateway (enables sombra_query)

ocultar_sombra_token.title: Sombra Bearer Token
ocultar_sombra_token.description: Enables sombra_query. Sombra rejects requests with no Bearer token — leave blank to disable this tool.

tools.name: refine_text
tools.description: Redact PII from text before sending to Claude

tools.name: reveal_tokens
tools.description: De-tokenize Ocultar tokens back to plaintext (auditor-only)

tools.name: register_entity
tools.description: Register a canonical PII entity and its variants (auditor-only)

tools.name: sombra_query
tools.description: Ask a redacted question via the Ocultar Sombra gateway
